summary: Boolean state predicate: reads a pointer to a per-vehicle AI/replay state object from this+0x3A9C and returns TRUE only when that pointer is non-null AND the dword at byte offset 300 inside the pointed object equals 1. Used by the overtaking system to test whether AI/replay driving is active for a vehicle.

operations.description: Load the AI/replay state object pointer v1 from this[3751] (dword index; byte offset 0x3A9C).
Guard: v1 must be non-null AND the dword at *(v1 + 300) must equal 1 for the function to return TRUE.
Called by Overtaking (0x0042AF70) on the frame path to gate overtaking logic on AI/replay activity.
